sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (schedule-dependent; SI bands 3L–7.5L and 10L+ affect room entitlement)

room_rent.note: SI 3L–7.5L: single private AC room; SI 10L and above: any room category. Proportionate deduction if higher room taken. Optional room rent capping at 1.5% of SI/day max ₹7,500 available for discount.

copayment.note: Voluntary co-pay of 10% or 20% available for premium discount; zone-based co-pay applies if Zone B/C insured treats in Zone A

sub_limits.display: Cataract 20% of SI/eye max ₹1L; Bariatric 50% of SI max ₹5L; Maternity sub-limits apply
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 20% of SI per eye max ₹1L; Bariatric: 50% of SI max ₹5L; Maternity: ₹15k/₹25k normal, ₹25k/₹35k caesarean by SI band

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹50,000/₹1,00,000/₹2,00,000/₹3,00,000 available for premium discount; not applied on maternity claims

specific_disease_waiting.note: 27 listed conditions including cataracts, hernia, fistula, mental illness, chronic kidney disease, Alzheimer's etc.

maternity.note: Max 2 deliveries/terminations; normal delivery ₹15k (SI≤7.5L)/₹25k (SI>7.5L); caesarean ₹25k/₹35k; 90-day post-natal covered within maternity limit; newborn covered within maternity SI

cumulative_bonus.note: Super Cumulative Bonus: 50% of base SI for year 1 and 2 (claim-free), then 10%/yr for next 5 years; max 150% of base SI; reduces by one slab after a claim year

restoration.note: Standard reinstatement: 100% base SI once per year after full SI+bonus exhausted. Additional Recharge Benefit: 20% of SI (up to ₹5L) if claim exceeds SI, once per year

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary cover mentioned for Health Guard section

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured in government or accredited AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered subject to Transplantation Act compliance

ambulance.note: Road ambulance; covers transfer to nearest hospital and inter-hospital transfer

modern_treatments.note: Annexure III list including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy etc.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are excluded; medical consumables within hospitalisation covered

notable_exclusions: No treatment outside India; no domiciliary; 72-mo maternity wait; 36-mo joint replacement/vertebral/bariatric wait; no IVF/infertility
optional_riders: Air ambulance (SI ≥5L), voluntary co-pay 10%/20%, voluntary aggregate deductible, room rent capping discount (1.5% of SI/day max ₹7,500)
